topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture, outlines the learning outcomes, and establishes the framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signal independence and oncogenic signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell surface receptors and downstream signaling cascades drive sustained proliferative signaling and growth factor independence.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how an arrest in terminal cell differentiation prevents cycle exit and promotes oncogenesis in hematopoietic and intestinal tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through p53 pathway inactivation and altered balance of Bcl-2 family proteins.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and growth control limits
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address telomere biology, mechanisms for bypassing senescence via telomerase upregulation, p53-mediated stress surveillance, and the transition out of cell-intrinsic growth control hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze altered cancer energetics, including aerobic glycolysis, tissue-of-origin metabolic profiles, and Krebs cycle mutations generating oncometabolites.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how growing tumors overcome diffusion limits by shifting the balance of regulatory factors to stimulate new blood vessel formation.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and secondary tumor colonization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the metastatic cascade, tracking dissemination with circulating tumor cells, microenvironmental compatibility in the seed and soil model, and the genomic features of metastases.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with summary observations on the hallmarks of cancer and practical housekeeping.
